output.summary: A perennial vine native to tropical South America, in what is now Ecuador. Its creeping stems root at their joints, while cultivars produce sweet, starchy storage roots in many skin and flesh colours. The roots are a major food, usually cooked, and young shoots and leaves are also eaten as greens.
output.edibilityNote: The starchy storage roots are staple food, usually cooked; young shoots and leaves are also eaten as greens.
